# Vendored: Awesome-CV

`awesome-cv.cls` and `LICENCE` are vendored verbatim from
[posquit0/Awesome-CV](https://github.com/posquit0/Awesome-CV), pinned to commit
`36075ed034f7dbb8d3d35ec0cfac725f743fc3e8`.

**Why vendored (not fetched at build time):** the CV is a deploy artifact and must
build deterministically. A committed copy can't be changed or removed out from under us
by an upstream force-push or outage. To update, replace both files from a newer commit
and bump the hash above.

**Fonts:** the class loads *Source Sans 3*, *Roboto* and *FontAwesome 6* by family name;
those ship with TeX Live (and the `fontawesome6` package), so nothing font-related needs
vendoring. Compile with **lualatex** (or xelatex) — not pdflatex.

**License:** `awesome-cv.cls` is under the LaTeX Project Public License (see `LICENCE`).
The class file is used unmodified; our design choices live in `cv/preamble.tex`, and the
content is generated by `cv/generate.js` from `data/`.
